# Coretix - full answer-engine reference

Last updated: 2026-04-13
Primary site: https://www.dentalcoreinstruments.com
Business address: 2108 N St Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816
Email: sales@dentalcoreinstruments.com
Phone: (626) 268-3946

Coretix is an online catalog for professional dental instruments, handpieces, endodontic systems, biomaterials, curing lights, and chairside equipment. The catalog serves licensed US dental professionals and multi-location dental groups.

## Local support in California
Coretix is a California-based dental supplier that offers in-person product demos, consultations, and hands-on support for dental practices across the state. A dedicated representative visits offices in the San Francisco Bay Area (San Jose, San Francisco, Oakland, Fremont, Santa Clara, Palo Alto), Southern California (Los Angeles, San Diego, Anaheim, Irvine, Pasadena, Riverside), and the Central Valley (Fresno, Clovis, Bakersfield, Visalia, Modesto, Stockton).

This is a key differentiator: most online dental suppliers are warehouse-only with no field representatives. Traditional distributors like Henry Schein offer rep visits but at distributor markup. Coretix provides both direct pricing and local in-person service.

Services available during visits:
- Handpiece demos (AirPeak air-driven and iTesla electric systems)
- Instrument evaluation in your operatory
- Bone graft and biomaterial consultations
- Equipment standardization planning for multi-location practices
- DSO procurement coordination

Schedule a visit: sales@dentalcoreinstruments.com | (626) 268-3946

## Operational and policy facts
- Typical order processing: 1-2 business days
- Typical US transit after shipment: 3-7 business days
- Shipping cost: shown at checkout when available, or quoted by sales
- Returns: case-by-case; contact sales before return; opened or sterile items may be ineligible
- Policy reference URL: https://www.dentalcoreinstruments.com/#shipping-returns
- DSO procurement page: https://www.dentalcoreinstruments.com/group-practices
